name: – Recital D – Am 1
title: PROPOSAL FOR A DECISION amending the decision of 18 December 2024 on setting up a special committee on the Housing Crisis in the European Union to extend the special committee’s term of office and adjust its responsibilities
part_text: D. whereas protecting people from evictions, protecting private property and ensuring legal certainty for private owners, including best practices in relation to the fight against criminal activities in the field of housing, with a priority focus on money laundering, are important aspects at national level affecting housing availability and the right to housing in certain Member States;
